A small Content Patcher mod that aims to replace all instances of (presumably American) crows in the game with one of their European* counterparts, the wonderful Hooded Crow ([i]Corvus cornix[/i]). As this is a purely visual mod, there should be no problems installing or de-installing it at any point during a playthrough.

Does this change make sense in a setting that also features raccoons and opossums, both of which are not native to Europe? You be the judge, I just like how they look!

Despite being a simple mod, I urge anyone who decides to try it out to [size=3][b]please report any encountered bugs[/b][/size] (visual or otherwise), especially if you're playing with mods I deliberately added compatibility for, as I am very new to all this and still have a lot to figure out. Thank you in advance.[line]

[color=#666666]* [i]Hooded crows do appear in parts of Asia and northern Africa as well, not just Europe. While 'Eurasian' is an accepted term, I don't know of one that includes all 3 continents, so I elected to just denote them as European for simplicity's sake, as that's the continent I also appear in.[/i][/color]
